02 — THE PERSON BEHIND THE PROJECTS

Curiosity first.
Craft follows.

I’m Tarun Tej, a web developer and AI/ML enthusiast based in Andhra Pradesh, India.

I’ve been learning web development since 2022, with around two years of hands-on building experience. Python has been part of my toolkit since 2023; I’m now going deeper into its libraries and the ideas behind them.

I enjoy turning an abstract problem into something people can use. That might be a maths practice tool, an interactive learning world, or a small C++ project that makes an engineering tradeoff visible.
